svg.title: feel — I didn't come this far just to come this far.
svg.desc: A monochrome engraved elephant and an illustrated map of ten projects. The strike sends a faint red afterglow through the connections. Each project performs its own miniature demo, and a compact rotating spotlight introduces the work. TypeShift and Doompedia lead, followed by Planora, SystemForge, RPS, MANTA, Anubis, Gems, Commit, and Portfolio. The links below open each repository. Connections are illustrative, not software dependencies.

g.text: Solo challenges, live races, and replays.
Play with words. Study how you type.
An offline feed of Wikipedia summaries.
An arcade with an economy behind it.
A browser becomes a puzzle box.
Build a playstyle out of powers.
Turn Git history into a chosen pattern.
A home for the work to meet.
